answer: Staked peer review, reduced to one number: 12 percent of grades are spot-checked by a random seat holding no stake in the answer. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a mirrored answer from last epoch fails on the first check. If the audit panel is not diverse the whole round voids and nobody is paid, which operators hate more than the bond. Cost per fake seat is one bond plus the risk that a voided round returns nothing. At dawn each epoch the pool resets, and the fable of passive income ends there.
